findings.text: Part B.7: `atalk login --local` does not read the existing project file, so the documented trust step fails. Reproduced with credential environment variables unset: `node bin/atalk.js login --local` exits 1 with `usage: atalk login --url <url> --token <atk_...>|- [--local]`. Document `atalk login --local --url <server> --token -` and pasting the existing token; update the repeated plugin README and troubleshooting instructions.

Part A: invalid-token MCP and unauthenticated SSE requests do not prove these services work in API-only mode. Reproduction: an in-memory Router.add mutation replaced POST /mcp with a handler returning 500; invoking it and applying this assertion produced `status=500; assertion PASSED`. Mint a valid test token and assert a successful MCP tools/list response and authenticated SSE delivery, retaining the authentication-denial checks.
